full_judgment: 2. Respondents instituted the above Money Suit for a decree of a sum of Tk. 1,0),000/-. Plaintiffs case in short is that while they were possessing .24 acres of land of khatian no. 555 under Mouja Bagbandor the defendants-petitioners dispossessed them and erected a tin shed but measuring 40x4 cubits on 5th January, 1994 in front of their newly constructed shops and godowns arid as a result, they could not let out those shops and godowns, for which, they had incurred a loss of Taka 1,50,000/-.
